scene_analysis.scene_overview: A sunny day in a city street corner with pedestrians walking along the sidewalk and a few tables outside a cafe. The street is paved with gray concrete and has a bike lane painted on it. There are tall buildings lining the street, including a large white building with many windows and balconies on the left and a smaller tan building with a flat roof on the right. A group of people are sitting at tables outside a cafe, and there are several streetlights and signs along the sidewalk. The sky is blue with some clouds.
